title: The Empty Platform
summary: A compact noir-Mythos encounter package for testing the staging API.

scenes.title: The Empty Platform
scenes.description: Rain needles an abandoned Pacific Electric platform. A lit carriage waits where no track remains.
scenes.objective: Discover who summoned the impossible car.
clues: Every timetable lists a different year.
A conductor's punch matches a scar on an investigator's hand.
scenes.keeperNotes: Reveal the second clue after a successful Spot Hidden check.

cast.name: The Sleepless Conductor
cast.description: A uniform filled with wet night air and the smell of hot copper.
cast.motivation: Collect the fare the investigators already owe.
cast.hook: It knows each investigator's childhood nickname.

handouts.title: Tomorrow's Timetable
handouts.body: PACIFIC ELECTRIC — LAST CAR 12:17 AM — PASSENGERS MUST PRESENT MEMORIES WITH FARE

encounters.title: Fare Due
encounters.hook: The carriage doors close without being touched.
encounters.clue: Ticket numbers correspond to sealed LAPD evidence boxes.
encounters.complication: The train begins moving through places erased from city maps.
encounters.stakes: A passenger loses a treasured memory at each stop.

metadata.tone: hardboiled noir and dreamlike cosmic horror
